intro.TrustedMarkup: Comparisons the compiler proves where a call states them. prove is compiler-known: the compiler reads it by this declaration. Asks the compiler to prove c where the call stands. c is one integer comparison or several joined by &&. A c the prover cannot show is a refusal that names the comparison and why, and after the call every later check may assume c. The call checks nothing at run time.
